recent_posts.title: Content partnership with Financial Times
recent_posts.summary: Financial Times announced a strategic partnership with OpenAI to enhance ChatGPT with attributed content, provide FT journalism in response to queries, and collaborate on developing new AI products and features. FT employees also have access to ChatGPT Enterprise. The agreement recognizes the value of FT's journalism and ensures transparency, attribution, and compensation for the use of AI platforms.

recent_posts.title: OpenAI’s commitment to child safety: adopting safety by design principles
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI and other industry leaders have committed to implementing robust child safety measures in the development, deployment, and maintenance of generative AI technologies. They prioritize child safety at every stage and actively engage with relevant organizations to mitigate risks. OpenAI commits to responsibly sourcing training datasets, deploying solutions to address misuse, releasing evaluated models, and maintaining model and platform safety.

recent_posts.title: Introducing improvements to the fine-tuning API and expanding our custom models program
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI introduces new features to enhance fine-tuning control with the API and expands the Custom Models Program to offer assisted fine-tuning and custom-trained models. The goal is to enable organizations to develop personalized AI models for their specific use cases.

recent_posts.title: Start using ChatGPT instantly
recent_posts.summary: ChatGPT is now available for instant use without needing to sign-up. Creating an account offers additional benefits such as saving chat history, sharing chats, and unlocking additional features.

recent_posts.title: Navigating the Challenges and Opportunities of Synthetic Voices
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI has developed Voice Engine, a model that generates natural-sounding speech using text input and a 15-second audio sample. Early applications include reading assistance, translating content, reaching global communities, supporting non-verbal people, and helping patients recover their voice. OpenAI is committed to building Voice Engine safely and engaging with partners to incorporate their feedback. They also highlight the need for voice authentication experiences and policies to protect individuals' voices in AI technology. The technology is being previewed but not widely released at this time.

recent_posts.title: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation
recent_posts.summary: The evaluation aims to measure whether AI models like GPT-4 increase access to information about biological threat creation compared to existing resources. The study found mild uplifts in accuracy and completeness for participants with access to GPT-4, but the effect sizes were not statistically significant. The evaluation highlights the need for more research to determine meaningful thresholds of increased risk. The methodology involved human participants, with experts having access to a research-only variant of GPT-4, and the tasks covered various stages of the biological threat creation process.

recent_posts.title: New embedding models and API updates
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI has released new embedding models, reduced prices for GPT-3.5 Turbo, and introduced new ways for developers to manage API keys and understand API usage.

recent_posts.title: Introducing the GPT Store
recent_posts.summary: Introducing the GPT Store where users can find and explore useful and popular GPTs. The store features diverse GPTs developed by partners and the community. Users can also include their own GPTs in the store. The GPT Store will launch a revenue program for builders in the future. Team and Enterprise customers have access to a private section of the store with enhanced controls.

recent_posts.title: Introducing ChatGPT Team
recent_posts.summary: Introducing ChatGPT Team, a new self-serve plan that offers access to advanced models like GPT-4 and DALL·E 3, along with tools like Advanced Data Analysis. It includes a dedicated collaborative workspace and admin tools for team management. ChatGPT Team does not train on your business data or conversations and provides a secure workspace for your team. Pricing starts at $25/month per user.

recent_posts.title: Practices for Governing Agentic AI Systems
recent_posts.summary: Agentic AI systems have the potential to help people achieve their goals more efficiently, but they also come with risks of harm. This article discusses the definition of agentic AI systems, the importance of baseline responsibilities and safety best practices, and provides an initial set of practices for keeping agents' operations safe and accountable.

top_posts.title: ChatGPT plugins
top_posts.summary: ChatGPT is introducing plugins, which allow language models to access external tools, retrieve information from the web, and interpret code. The plugins are being gradually rolled out to users and developers, with safety considerations in place to mitigate risks. Several companies have already created plugins, and open standards are expected to emerge for AI-facing interfaces.

top_posts.title: ChatGPT: Optimizing Language Models for Dialogue
top_posts.summary: ChatGPT is a sibling model to InstructGPT, which is trained to follow an instruction in a prompt and provide a detailed response. The dialogue format makes it possible for ChatGPT to answer followup questions, admit its mistakes, challenge incorrect premises, and reject inappropriate requests.

top_posts.title: Introducing ChatGPT Plus
top_posts.summary: The new subscription plan, ChatGPT Plus, will be available for $20/month, and subscribers will receive a number of benefits. Priority access to new features and improvements are available to customers in the United States. We will begin the process of inviting people from our waitlist over the coming weeks.

top_posts.title: OpenAI Residency
top_posts.summary: The OpenAI Residency offers a pathway to a full-time role at OpenAI for researchers and engineers who don't currently focus on artificial intelligence. Residents will be compensated as fully salaried employees for the duration of the program. The Residency shifts the focus away from curriculum-based learning, instead giving Residents an opportunity to work collaboratively.

top_posts.title: GPT-4
top_posts.summary: OpenAI has released GPT-4, a large multimodal model that exhibits human-level performance on professional and academic benchmarks. It has improved factuality, steerability, and adherence to safety standards. The model has been tested on various benchmarks and outperforms previous models in language tasks. It also shows promise in handling visual inputs. However, it still has limitations and biases in its outputs. OpenAI is working on safety measures and collaborating with external researchers to assess potential impacts. GPT-4 is available for ChatGPT Plus subscribers and the API has a waitlist for access.
